description: This file contains a database seeding script for a railway ticket booking system. It defines a seed() function that initializes database tables with sample data including stations, a train, route, schedule, coach, seats, and seat inventories. The script uses SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions and can be run directly to populate the database with initial data.

methods.description: Main function that initializes the database with sample data for stations, train, route, schedule, coach, seats, and seat inventories.
